rationale: Long dead time followed by a prompt response does not distinguish fixed waiting from a processing-capacity shortage. Capacity constraints can coexist with fixed waiting or delay when a response becomes observable. Even as a tentative constraint on explanations, the signal does not license excluding capacity shortage at the tested operating point.
signal_basis: - Long dead time followed by a prompt response suggests the handoff holds items in fixed waiting (scheduled review, batch release, transfer latency), not a shortage of processing capacity.
